_comment: WHICH PHYSICAL FEED EACH CORRELATOR ELEMENT IS, AS A FUNCTION OF TIME.
Elements are keyed by CORRELATOR element index (0..127); only the live ones appear.
The beam cube packs a 32-wide axis in `cube_order` below -- cube index i is correlator
element cube_order[i]. THESE ARE DIFFERENT AXES (cube pol*16+dish, correlator pol*64+dish)
and crossing them silently mislabels every polarisation. Resolve, never compute.
'plane' labels the two physical feed planes A and B. Which is X and which is Y is NOT
determined by the measurement behind it (a contrast split, relative between dishes), so
never promote A/B to X/Y without an absolute reference.
AN EPOCH IS AN IDENTITY INTERVAL, NOT A HEALTH INTERVAL. An element going dark does not
start a new epoch; a recabling, a re-pointing or a change to live_element_ranges does.
Data outside every listed interval RAISES -- the resolver never extrapolates.
(viscap_20260907 survey, 7 satellites x 24 chunks, placement gate 10 ns / 1 m); feed-plane
split from the beam-contrast clustering over 2026-09-05..08 (docs/CHORD_BEAM_MAPS.md).
Names are [row letter][column number]: rows A southernmost 8.5 m, columns 01
westernmost 6.3 m. ENU metres relative to correlator element 0 (dish A01 slot 0).

epochs.name: 2026-08-29-baseline
notes: Dishes A06, A07, B07 (9, 10, 14) carry the feed planes the other way round: slot 0 is
plane B there and plane A everywhere else. Three independent indicators flip on exactly
those three (contrast split, the lower-gain pol being the higher-contrast one, and a
cos(2phi) fit to the 12-25 deg skirt).
Six dishes were never classified: B01, B02, B04 (dark LNAs) and A05, B05, B08 (one pol
degraded). B06 is ambiguous -- its indicators disagree. Those carry plane null.
valid_from is the date of the first written mapping, not a claim that nothing changed
earlier; there is no record before it, so earlier data raises.

epochs.name: 2026-09-14-polswap
epochs.provenance: site log via KV 2026-09-18: rewire at 2026-09-14 15:08 ET = 19:08Z; confirmed on sky from the 20260915..17 maps (fixtures/beamcube/static_l5mid_0915_0917/slot_swap_check.py)
notes: VERIFIED ON SKY 2026-09-18, on KV's call, from the first post-swap beam maps (20260915,
16, 17 -- fixtures/beamcube/static_l5mid_0915_0917/). Plane B is the higher-gain plane,
so a rewired dish must FLIP the sign of its (slot1 - slot0) fitted gain and an untouched
one must not. Measured, over dishes healthy in both epochs:
untouched (n=7) mean -0.04 dB, max |change| 0.56 dB
A06/A07/B07    mean +1.98 dB, min |change| 1.64 dB
the majority. The smallest rewired change is 2.9x the largest untouched one -- no overlap.
⚠️ THE BASIS IS ONE INDICATOR, the gain ordering -- not all three that fixed the baseline
planes (contrast split, lower-gain pol being the higher-contrast one, cos(2phi) skirt fit).
It confirms the REPORTED swap rather than re-deriving the planes from scratch. If the
planes are ever disputed, run the full contrast split before arguing from this line.
⚠️ B06 (dish 13) moved -0.56 dB, the largest untouched mover. Its baseline value was
+0.04 dB -- no ordering at all -- and B06 is flagged ambiguous, so its sign says nothing.
Whether the site team also touched A05, B05, B08 (which were flagged UNTESTED when the
three were reported) is UNKNOWN -- they stay plane null either way, so the table is not
wrong if they did, only less complete.
BOUNDARY CORRECTED 2026-09-18. This epoch first read 2026-09-16T00:00Z with a
deliberate one-day gap, on the belief that the swap happened some unrecorded hour of
2026-09-15 and that GNSS was off so nothing was lost. Both halves were wrong: the site
log puts the rewire at 2026-09-14 15:08 ET (19:08Z), and 2026-09-15 is a FULL GNSS day
(8487 raw files, 204 GB of L0, 00:00:00-23:59:59 on one F-engine epoch). The gap was
silently costing the best day in the window. 2026-09-14 now straddles the boundary and
refuses, which is correct and cheap -- that is the day data was barely flowing.

epochs.name: 2026-10-20-rows-af96
epochs.provenance: live_element_ranges [[0,47],[64,111]] (KV 2026-10-19: 96 inputs); F-engine delivers rows A-G since 2026-10-19 (chord b612f57a4, missing_source_ids [7, 15])
notes: Rows A-F, both pols. Row G (48-55) is live on the F-engine but cannot be added alone: ranges are
16-aligned and 48-63 would bring the silent row H.
A/B positions: the refined third pass (config/elem_positions_refined_20260927.json, possolve, 35 h);
pol-1 slots take their dish's pol-0 position; B01/B02/B04 keep their epoch E/N (unsolved, dark).
C-F positions: NOMINAL, the telescope.j2 8x8 grid mapped onto those refined A/B positions by a 2-D
similarity fit (13 pol-0 dishes: rotation -0.016 deg, scale 0.99996, E/N residual median 0.013 m, max 0.029 m)
with heights from the same fit's plane. Re-solve them (possolve.py, or a vis capture) before trusting
them past a few cm; rows C-F are tipped, so their phase centres may move at the realignment.
Feed planes of C-F are unmeasured (null).

epochs.name: 2026-10-23-rows-ah128
epochs.provenance: live_element_ranges [[0,63],[64,127]] (KV 2026-10-23: 128 inputs); row H delivers again since the chord merge of 2026-10-23 (missing_source_ids [])
notes: Rows A-H, both pols.
A/B: the refined third pass (2026-09-27), carried from 2026-10-20-rows-af96.

C-F and B04: the 2026-10-23 solve (fixtures/elemsteer/pos_cf_20261023.py, out/pos_cf_converge_20261023.txt): in-group positions within 3 cm of the grid (window split <= 0.7 cm), plus the group offset T = (+0.012, -0.560, -0.160) m from the A/B grid (coherence ~0.64: a hypothesis to confirm on sky). Dark C08, D04, F01, E07 take the grid plus T.
G/H: NOMINAL, the telescope.j2 grid mapped onto the A/B positions by the af96 similarity fit (reproduces af96's C-F nominal to <= 1.7 mm), plus T (tipped with C-F). Solve them on 128-element data.
Valid until the realignment: the C-F/G/H phase centres move with the tip.

epochs.name: 2026-10-24-rows-ah120-taua
epochs.provenance: live_element_ranges [[0,63],[64,127]] as 2026-10-24-rows-ah128-taua: the correlator axis keeps row H's 8 Y-pol slots (120-127) because dish slots 48-63 share the 16-wide gather tile 7 with row G; opened at the F-engine outage of ~18:00Z in which the board carrying row H's Y pol was removed and G01/G02 were recabled (KV 2026-10-24 20:15Z, corrected 2026-10-25)
notes: Rows A-H X pol and rows A-G Y pol, 120 feeds: the same elements, cube order and positions as 2026-10-24-rows-ah128-taua for the feeds that stay. Row H's Y pol is removed from the array (KV 2026-10-24: "Row H is being removed altogether", corrected 2026-10-25: "only H-y is out, the H-x should still be good"; the F-engine board carrying it is gone); H01X..H08X (elements 56-63) stay live. The 8 Y-pol slots, elements 120-127, stay in cube_order: the dual correlator gathers 16-wide element tiles and dish slots 48-63 share tile 7 with row G (config/gen_chord_gnss_config.py live_tile_columns refuses a partial column), so the element axis cannot drop them without a gather change. Their records carry `removed` and keep H's positions so the steering stays finite. bffs flags H01-H08 Y, and since kotekan d5c07bde2 the generator takes bffs's flagged inputs out of the projection stations, the channel-noise inputs and the shared reference.

G01 and G02: the cabling error at the feed is fixed (KV 2026-10-24: "G01 and G02 have had their pols swapped at the analog end, they each had a cabling error at the feed itself"), so the recv1 README's X/Y swap for those two dishes goes away: from this epoch the feed plane that reached slot 0 (elements 48, 49) reaches slot 1 (112, 113) and vice versa. Nothing else changes; positions are per dish. Both dishes are unclassified (plane null), so the swap is recorded on the four records (`recabled`) and here, not in the plane column; the shared reference's entries for the four elements are swapped to match (config/elem_shared_ref_20261024_ah120.json).
Aim: pointing p5_taua_20261024 unchanged, H01 included (H01X is live, aimed 30.000 deg S per the site map). E01 at zenith and F01/F02/F03/G01/H01 at 30.000 deg S stay as exceptions.
Positions: the 2026-10-24 Tau A solve (config/elem_positions_taua_20261024.json) carried over unchanged per dish into config/elem_positions_taua_20261024_ah120.json under this epoch's key.

History: kotekan 9dad9217e first recorded this interval as 2026-10-24-rows-ag112-taua with all 16 row-H slots removed, on KV's first word that row H was gone altogether; corrected to this record before any node started on it (its configs were written at 2026-10-25 01:10Z and never used), so no artifact carries the ag112 key.
Built by fixtures/elemsteer/epoch_ah120_20261024.py.
